query_generation.eligible_task_rule: official task has exactly one GT OBB
query_generation.pair_rule: all eligible tasks in manifest order with target index less than reference index
query_generation.axis_selection: larger absolute displacement of anchor x and z; x wins exact ties
query_generation.negative_rule: same target/reference with the exact opposite directional relation

inference.scene_memory: all permanent A2 objects; no GT filtering

evaluation.positive_correct_strict: answered top-1 object center lies inside official target OBB
evaluation.positive_correct_uncertainty: answered top-1 object center lies inside target OBB padded by measured alignment RMSE
evaluation.negative_correct: query abstained; correct rejections never increase answer coverage
evaluation.risk_coverage: risk among emitted answers as coverage grows over the full frozen query set
